notes:
1. Interactive Business Intelligence Dashboard: Connected Counter Cash in Hand, Gross Sales, Khata Receivables, Supplier Payables, and Gross Profit. Added quick actions for Customer Cash Collection and Supplier Payments.
2. Recent Invoices Register: High-density register with smart filters (Today, Yesterday, Week, All Bills, Tax Invoices, Estimates, Payment Modes) and clean commercial English column headers.
3. Purchases & Supplier Banking System: High-density Supplier Directory grid with copyable UPI IDs and Bank A/c details. Complete Pay Supplier modal supporting UPI, NEFT, Cheque, and Cash with automated Accounts vouchers.
4. Site Bookings Payment Collection: Instant '+ Collect Payment' action on Site Orders, auto-reducing balance due, updating Counter Cash, and creating financial receipt vouchers.
5. Staff Salary Settlement Fix: Complete monthly settlement workflow with payment mode selection, advance deduction, and salary voucher generation.
6. Online Payment Integration Guide: Comprehensive architecture guide explaining Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, Cashfree, PhonePe), 0% UPI MDR, and merchant vs customer fee absorption.
